about: The strings plan 179.1-81 writes, as its checkpoint (Task 1) presents them, each at its recommended answer: the fr and lb values that are the English of the base locale, which the per-value comparison of the untranslated-catalogue guard finds (the operator's ruling A4 at the WR16I UAT, test 4). en is the unchanged source each translation was made from; fr and lb are machine translations, flagged for a native reader. questions.arguments.title is written in lb alone: the fr value, Arguments, is the French word, and goes on the guard's allowlist. Where the operator's answer edits a string, plan 81 replaces that value here, word for word, before anything is written, and commits this file alone. 179.1-approved-strings.mjs reads this file together with every other 179.1-<n>-approved-strings.json beside it and compares the catalogues with all of them, per locale and key.
